sources.title: Open sourcing Sweep Next-Edit v2 and our inference runtime
sources.snippet: The model Sweep Next-Edit v2 predicts your next code edit before you make it, just like v1 — but at 7B parameters it has more headroom for the harder, longer-range edits where the smaller model struggled. Everything we wrote up about our training format and data still applies.

sources.title: Sweep AI Blog
sources.snippet: Today we're releasing Sweep Next-Edit: a 1.5B parameter model that predicts your next code edit before you make it. It can run locally on your laptop in under 500ms, and outperforms models over 4x its size on next-edit benchmarks. We're open sourcing the model weights so the community can build fast, privacy-preserving autocomplete for every IDE - VSCode, Neovim, Emacs, and beyond.
